breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions, which are contradictory. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the periodic condition, only including the instruction: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t) = 0 and u(1,t) = 0'.
